detail.installAppTitle: Install in the Claude app (no terminal)
detail.installAppStep1: Download the ZIP with the button below.
detail.installAppStep2: In Claude, open Settings → Capabilities and turn on 'Code execution and file creation'. (one time)
detail.installAppStep3: Go to Customize → Skills → + → 'Upload a skill' and upload the ZIP.
